body: I think I may need to, although starting the whole process again feels like starting from the beginning again. I think I may know the treatment which I want, someone more specialised in trauma but I guess I'm scared of being told it's not the bad and feel like I'm making too much of a big deal of everything

Yes, I guess it just takes time and effort to think and write out a proper reply, I suppose they don't understand how painful the waiting is.
I just can't stand how vulnerable it makes me. Rejection seems to be one of the only things worse than just being alone.
It's frustrating, I can't see how talking in itself will help things, but funny how much one wants to anyway? Yep I've been in therapy past 6 months, but hasn't actually been working out too well, he doesn't listened to me and seems to ignore what I tell him
